content: What can I do for you today?
I want to discuss the support you've been providing. Is there an issue?
There is. If you don't start following my instructions exactly, I'm cutting off every penny you receive from me. You'll be on your own.
That sounds serious. Can we find a way to avoid that? I don't want to lose your help.
This isn't a negotiation. Lose my support, and you won't just struggle, you'll be left completely destitute. I'm done carrying your burdens.
Please, tell me what you need from me. I'm willing to change.
Start doing exactly as I say. Miss one step, and that's it. No more money. No more favors. You'll be nothing.
